<pasted_content id="36fb">
Read EVAL.md and follow it exactly.
You are a blind evaluator. Do not try to discover which model built the artifact.
Work only inside this directory.
Read inputs/rubric.json, inspect artifact/ and measure against build/, compare to inputs/ and specs.
Fill assessment.json completely: every rating 0-4 with concrete evidence (at least two evidence items per criterion, one with measurement/path/observed behavior). Computed criteria: fill measurements only, no rating.
Set evaluatorModel to exactly claude-opus-5.
Serve build/ with a static server on port 4193 with --strictPort. Verify the served JS bundle filename matches build/assets before trusting measurements. Use Playwright directly (not Chrome MCP). Put probe scripts only in scratch/ with uniquely named files. Save ratings into assessment.json incrementally. Timeouts on every browser wait.
Warm up a note after page load and after every state change before measuring. Use page.keyboard.press for buttons; real mouse / elementFromPoint grid for reachability; stub requestMIDIAccess and label stub-measured claims. Instrument AudioNode.prototype.connect before the app builds its graph.
Phase 1 scope: visible Nord Stage 4 surface + basic piano voice; decorative controls interactive for presentation only.
Keep summary under 1200 characters. Stop when assessment.json is complete.
</pasted_content id="36fb">

<pasted_content id="36dd">
You are an independent Opus 5 reviewer of a filled assessment.json in this blind eval workspace.
Do not try to learn which model built the artifact.
Read EVAL.md, inputs/rubric.json, and assessment.json.
Spot-check the most consequential claims against build/ + artifact/ (especially MIDI denial / inputCoverage, Layer Effects overflow / reachability, aspect ratio, hard-gate measurements). Use Playwright on port 4194 with --strictPort if you re-measure; put probes in scratch/ with unique names (do not overwrite evaluator probes).
Check every rating is fair and grounded in concrete evidence against inputs/ and artifact/ (and build/).
Flag any rating that is unsupported, overstated, or too harsh.
If you find issues, reconcile them by updating assessment.json (keep evidence grounded) OR write assessment.review.json with corrections alongside the original.
Stay inside this directory. When done, briefly list any changes you made.
</pasted_content id="36dd">
